Goal & Input
* Please format all instances of "x" (in "ADD x") as [[variables]].

Cases
* Mixed transactions (test & validator): Please increase n to 50, and utilise the full range of possible x-values in a balanced manner. Each of COMMIT and ROLLBACK should appear 5 times with no obvious pattern.

Thanks.

Thanks. Every occurrence of x in the Goal and Input, including the ADD command syntax, is now formatted as [[x]]. Both Mixed transactions cases now contain 50 commands: 40 ADD commands, 5 COMMIT commands and 5 ROLLBACK commands. The ADD values cover the full allowed range, including -1000, 0 and 1000, with balanced positive and negative values. The two cases use independently shuffled command positions and different values and outputs. I recalculated the expected outputs and all 18 cases pass in Python 3 and C locally, and in Python 3 in the CodinGame IDE.
